# Design and engine assumptions: work/plan_20261117/research_1337/regions/yuan_y3.md
# Unit variables at on_game_start (like oe_theme_regions). The countries' variables, a missing seat office or subject
# relation, and the governors are checked after the lobby (when vanilla china_set_up has certainly run, so the loyalty start
# value sees yua_dictator_powers). Both are guarded by global variables and run once per campaign.
on_game_start = { on_actions = { oe_yp_game_start } }
on_game_started_after_lobby = { on_actions = { oe_yp_after_lobby } }
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_yp_monthly_pulse } }

oe_yp_game_start = {
    effect = { oe_yp_assign_units = yes }
}
oe_yp_after_lobby = {
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_started } }
            set_global_variable = oe_yp_started
            oe_yp_assign_units = yes
            oe_yp_setup_countries = yes
            oe_yp_setup_rulers = yes
        }
    }
}
oe_yp_monthly_pulse = {
    trigger = { country_type = building is_subject_type = oe_yp_xingsheng }
    effect = { oe_yp_monthly = yes }
}
